name: Agram
summary: A West African trick-taking card game where only the sixth and final trick determines the winner.
rules_text: From a standard 52-card deck remove all kings, queens, jacks, deuces, and the ace of spades. Remaining rank per suit high to low is A-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3, except spades whose highest is 10 since the ace is missing. Shuffle and deal six cards to each player, three at a time. Player left of dealer leads any card. Clockwise, each player must follow suit if able; otherwise they may discard any card, but an off-suit card cannot win the trick. Highest card of the led suit wins the trick and collects it. The trick winner leads to the next trick. Play six tricks total. The player who wins the sixth trick wins the game outright.
